# COMPSCI 879 lecture decks

Reveal.js decks for *Teaching Assistants as Tomorrow's Faculty*, UMass Amherst CICS, Fall 2026.

Published at <https://timdrichards.github.io/cs879-decks/>.

**Do not edit these files here.** They are generated. The source lives in the course repository
under `course/units/<unit>/slides.html`, and this copy is produced by
`course/slides/publish_decks.py`, which strips the presenter notes before publishing.

To update: rebuild the decks, run the publish script, then commit and push from this directory.
